sources.title: EU AI Act — high-risk AI (Annex III §1(a))
sources.why: Defines the high-risk tier, the central category an mHealth AI must check itself against when classifying its risk.

sources.title: EU AI Act — transparency obligations (Art. 50)
sources.why: Sets the limited/transparency-risk tier that applies when an AI system is not classified as high-risk.

sources.title: EU AI Act — GPAI model provider (Art. 53/55)
sources.why: Classifies whether substantial fine-tuning makes you a GPAI model provider, a distinct AI Act risk category.
